newsitem.title: USA: Orange County says will not raise tender premiums.
newsitem.headline: Orange County says will not raise tender premiums.

text.p: Orange County, Calif., said on Wednesday it does not plan to increase the tender premiums for its taxable pension obligation bonds Series 1994A.
Recent market developments should make the tender prices more attractive to bondholders, county finance officials said.
Last month, the county Board of Supervisors adopted a resolution authorizing the tender offer of the county's taxable refunding pension obligation bonds.
The proposal calls for the county to sell up to $200 million of debt to refund the outstanding bonds.
